summary.text: Phil Fortunato is a Republican member of the Washington State Senate from District 31, which he has represented since January 7, 2017, and he is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Tamara Stramel (D).
He previously served in the Washington House of Representatives from 1998 to 2000.

paragraphs.text: Fortunato lives in Auburn, Washington, and his career experience includes working as a landscaper and as the owner and founder of Eco-3.
He represented House District 47-Position 1 from 1998 to 2000.
In the 2023-2024 session he served on the Housing, State Government, Tribal Relations & Elections, and Senate Transportation committees and the Joint Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee.
